title: `AudioStreamPlayer.get_playback_position` has an initial lag of around 1 second before starting on Web builds
body: ### Tested versions - Reproducible in 4.6.2 stable. ### System information Godot v4.6.2.stable - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3050 Laptop GPU (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.7640) - 11th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-11400H @ 2.70GHz (12 threads) - 15.78 GiB memory ### Issue description When playing an OGG/MP3/WAV stream in web exports using the default playback type, (Sample) the return value of `AudioStreamPlayer.get_playback_position()` consistently gets stuck at the beginning for around 1 second before actually starting, even though the stream is already playing. This also happens in subsequent replays and not just the first playback. https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/855c9179-8e3f-4018-aaea-961f9bf940cd Note that this bug occurred using Google Chrome as the browser. I'm not sure if other browsers are affected as well but likely it's the same for all Chromium-based browsers. ### Steps to reproduce * Open the MRP and use Remote Deploy to deploy the project to Web. * Observe that `get_playback_position` is stuck for around a second before starting. * The same thing occurs for the other MP3 and WAV streams attached in the MRP if you try to assign them to the AudioStreamPlayer in the main scene. * Try setting the default playback type for web builds from "Sample" to "Stream", and observe that the issue goes away. * Also note that this issue does not occur for PC builds. You can already see this by playing the main scene inside the editor. ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) [mrp-web-audio-playback-position-delay.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/27543735/mrp-web-audio-playback-position-delay.zip) (Note: WAV files are omitted because adding them would easily make the project exceed the 10 MB limit. I recommend going to opengameart to pick a test case if needed, such as [this one](https://opengameart.org/content/theme-song-8-bit).)
